Historical example of Buffett's anchor thesis: company that consistently exceeds forward earnings estimates, making it appear cheap in retrospect; pattern ongoing since 2012 per Cramer's discussion.
Well-managed CPG stock used as example: can rally on defensive sector rotation (recession hedging) rather than fundamental improvements; shows importance of understanding true drivers of moves.
